reviews.review:
This is not a good single player game. 4/10 at best.

The Aliens branding is doing all the work. It's mobile shooter quality. The story serves as a reason to go shoot swarms of NPCs.  If it was not for the Colonial Marines skin on the weapons and player character this game would have no redeeming qualities.  The aliens are awful, reduced to swarming blobs of yellow. It is an insult to the franchise. I think the synth enemies are meant to carry the game.  The two environments I played are completely generic and fail to draw you into the world. It feels like a place to shoot swarms of NPCs.

The biggest insult to single players is the crash test dummies, Alpha and Beta who are tossed in as fillers for humans.  They are literal synth bots with a gun - they can not be customized, assigned roles or loadouts, they do not provide banter. They destroy any hope of immersion.

Milage may vary if co-op multiplayer is your thing. 

I purchased this game in a bundle with Aliens: Dark Descent (a game that, while not perfect, handles the franchise with much more care)

Neutral review.

This is probably fun for a group of friends who have the time and patience to figure out all of the mechanics that the game doesn't bother telling you. It has some of the feel of the Aliens movies, but in the end it's just another squad shooter vs. alien waves. The game can be tough, even on casual, and there are no in-mission saves as far as I can tell. You can apparently level up your guy and find upgraded equipment, but it gets a bit stale after a few hours since, again, it's just marine squad vs. alien mobs over and over again.

I got this for $6 and still requested a refund. Don't bother unless you are playing multiplayer and don't mind mindless shooting at enemy swarms.

In this you take the role of a Colonial Marine as you explore a new planet within the Aliens universe. 3 player coop with the following play styles:
Gunner:  Basic shooty boi
Demolisher: Heavy weapons
Technician: Area control
Doc: "BROTHER I NEED A APOTHCARY!" 
Phalanx: Sword/sheild < Shotgun/Sheild
Lancer: Imma firing my laser
Recon: Sniper/detection

With a small skill tree, customize your Marine's fighting style to better suit you and not to mention...THE DRIP   
It has 4 campaign missions (5 with DLC) with INTENSE being the standard difficulty to play on, its surely is a good coop game.
